data.name: Billal
data.gender_notes: Billal is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Billal means 'determined' or 'firm'. This powerful name is associated with the Prophet Billal ibn Rabah, who is known for his unwavering faith and courage. The name Billal carries the meaning “Determined, Firm” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Billal usually hope their child will grow to embody determined, firm and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Billal is a reminder of the unwavering faith and courage that is required to navigate life's challenges and stay true to one's beliefs.
data.etymology: Billal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Determined, Firm.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Billal total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The Prophet Billal ibn Rabah was a pre-Islamic Arabian building contractor who renounced his polytheistic faith and became a monotheist, embracing the monotheistic religion that was to become Islam. He became a noted figure among the pre-Islamic Arabs. Billal is remembered in Islamic history for his determination and strength in his faith and lifestyle, which served as an inspiration to many. His name carries with it a strong historical and cultural significance in the Islamic world.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Billal signifies determination and unwavering faith in the face of adversity. It is a reminder of the Prophet Billal's courage and commitment to his faith, which serves as an inspiration to those who bear this name. The name Billal is also a reminder of the importance of adhering to the commandments of Allah and staying steadfast in the midst of life's challenges. Ultimately, the spiritual significance of the name Billal is a reminder of the power of faith and determination to overcome even the most significant obstacles.

historical_references.reference: Billal ibn Rabah was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). He was born in Mecca and was the first person to embrace Islam in Mecca after Khadija (ra) and Abu Bakr (ra). He was known for his strong faith and dedication to Islam, despite facing persecution and harassment from the Meccan polytheists.
